title: Emergency Main Line Repair at Benz Circle

who: Residents of Benz Circle, Patamata Lanka, Gurunanak Colony, and Ward 32.
why: Heavy vehicular load caused joint displacement on aged distribution main line.
relief_measures: Water tankers dispatched to main intersections. Call 0866-2424111 for doorstep delivery.

who: Labbipet, MG Road (Pinnamaneni Polyclinic Road to DV Manor), Ward 24.
why: Overheating mitigation following consecutive 42°C+ peak temperatures in Vijayawada.
relief_measures: Alternate supply routed through Governorpet grid for critical medical facilities.

title: Advisory: Understanding Your Summer Electricity Bill Slabs
summary: High domestic consumption pushes units into higher tariff slabs (Rs 7.10/unit).
what: Guidance on why May & June electricity bills reflect higher average cost per unit.
who: All domestic consumers in APCPDCL Vijayawada Circle.
why: APCPDCL uses a telescopic slab structure. Air conditioning for an extra 4 hours daily adds ~120-150 units, which fall into Slab 4 and 5.
relief_measures: Use the 'Saral Bill Explainer' tool to see your exact unit calculation and savings tips.

who: Auto Nagar commercial and domestic lines.
why: Faulty isolator replaced and line cleared by APCPDCL emergency squad.
relief_measures: Grid functioning normally at standard 230V voltage.
